entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker created by Urza who searches the Caves of Koilos for the secret of the sylex and discovers a Phyrexian staging ground on Dominaria.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A Tolarian academy acolyte with a mechanical eye who tends Sheoldred, fights and traps Karn, and escapes the staging ground.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor, half scorpion-like machine and half humanoid, who has crossed to Dominaria and is being repaired at a staging ground.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Karn's friend who writes him unanswered letters urging him to come back and doubts that Phyrexians are on Dominaria.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A lost friend of Karn and Jhoira whose spark protects Karn from Phyrexian subversion.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Karn's creator, a planeswalker artificer who used Karn as a weapon and once taught him about pain.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Karn's creation who renamed Karn's plane and was taken by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A figure whose blessings the female acolyte invokes.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Gray-robed human acolytes who serve the Phyrexians on Dominaria and tend the staging ground.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders now secretly present on Dominaria, who compleat people and plant sleeper agents.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: A cave network on Dominaria, once a Thran prison, where Karn digs for the secret of the sylex.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane that Karn believes is threatened by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Karn's former plane, originally named Argentum, lost to the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexian staging ground
entities.description: A Phyrexian base in a vast cavern with surgical tables, a portal ship, skyships and a dragon engine.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A copper-like goblet-shaped device with inscriptions that Karn believes can be used against the Phyrexians, though he does not know how to operate it.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: The ancient civilization whose prisoners and technology are buried in the Caves of Koilos.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The void between planes that burned away parts of Sheoldred during her passage.

events.summary: Karn repairs a broken excavator in the Caves of Koilos and recalls Jhoira doubting that the Phyrexians are on Dominaria.
events.quote: Karn placed his hand on the excavator.

events.summary: The excavator opens a sealed Thran workshop, and Karn finds a diagram of the sylex and a clay tablet with matching symbols.
events.quote: a diagram of the sylex painted on parchment

events.summary: Karn returns to camp, where Jhoira's unanswered letters lie, and examines the sylex, which shocks him.
events.quote: The sylex sent a jolt through him.

events.summary: Karn recalls Urza teaching him about pain and the loss of Mirrodin, which he believes was his fault.
events.quote: The Phyrexians had taken it from him.

events.summary: Digging near the workshop, Karn finds living Phyrexian cables embedded in the rock and tears one free, causing a cave-in that destroys the workshop and blocks his way back.
events.quote: The other cables contracted within the wall—and the ceiling to the ancient workshop thundered to the ground.

events.summary: Karn follows the Phyrexian tunnel and defeats two Society of Mishra acolytes, who warn him that Sheoldred welcomes him and that others are coming.
Karn finds the Phyrexian staging ground, where acolytes compleat humans and Sheoldred hangs suspended.
events.quote: He'd found the staging ground of the Phyrexian invasion.

events.summary: An acolyte raises an alarm, the Phyrexians begin evacuating, and Rona attacks Karn with a glaive.
Karn fights through Sheoldred's worshippers on a bridge and reaches the praetor.
events.quote: Karn pushed himself to his feet and charged down the narrow stone bridge.

events.summary: Karn defeats Rona, breaking her mechanical eye, but refuses to kill her, saying he is not a weapon.
When Karn touches Sheoldred, she whispers to him and he learns Phyrexian sleeper agents are hidden in every land of Dominaria.
events.quote: Phyrexian sleeper agents lurked in every land in Dominaria

events.summary: As Karn plants an incendiary device inside Sheoldred, Rona's magic paralyzes him.
events.quote: But his hand did not move.

events.summary: Rona tells Karn the forces have evacuated to secondary staging areas, and Sheoldred splits into spider-like pieces that scatter over him.
events.quote: Sheoldred split apart, dividing herself up in pieces.

events.summary: Rona taunts Karn about Memnarch and collapses the cavern onto him.
events.quote: Tons of rock poured onto him.

events.summary: Buried, Karn cannot planeswalk because of interference and is trapped, the only one who knows Sheoldred is on Dominaria.

relations.quote: "I may not be able to stop you, Urza's creation,"

relations.note: Karn created Memnarch and gave him intelligence.
Jhoira writes to Karn, begging him to come back.
Rona repairs Sheoldred and calls her the Whispering One.
relations.quote: "Sheoldred, in her beauty, my Whispering One," Rona said
Acolytes in the gray robes of the Society of Mishra attended surgical machines

relations.note: Karn tries to destroy Sheoldred with an incendiary device.
relations.quote: Karn reached between the plates on her thorax and deposited the incendiary device inside her body.

relations.note: They fight and she buries him.
relations.quote: "Your mistake," she said, "was not killing me when you had the chance.
